<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>RBI policy shift:</strong> The Reserve Bank of India raised the repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.50%—the first hike since 2023—while lifting the FY27 GDP growth forecast to 7.1% and shifting its stance to &quot;calibrated tightening&quot; to combat rising inflation.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiwFBVV95cUxOOWk2YzNQOFVNVElyaW9EbGxqYV8waGJIeHZSZDZZOWVCRld5akVua2NRcTVlMU1vUS1MblY0cWxBWjg3M0VobVd5OVlUMGNTazM1NGNfTllVUGJXbjVsNTNmaG44d0JwamJtQ3JvU1V4a2ZaTDhKUzZ6aHZ5SG5SMXkyb3NYYUdYVFI4?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitgFBVV95cUxNdndEV1U4NTF4UTdkdFlHbFk3dUF5Y3NEdWdWWTdwOWJPV0NnUDFqTjFMM3ZpVFU3QlBaeHUtX05ZQ2lSUUtZNkZHZ2I3YlVjTk1FYXlKWVVXRXRLUTd4N01xQ3RpdmlZenV0bWFPMFdVVERzS2ZGWmNVcWxlU05ISUdxOEFUS3BjME4zMkw2QjJCRWtMXzJLdFB1UnhtXzRUeGpRRmx6WFE4TVJwR0Vtb3FCTDh4UQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I21</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I58</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Market and yield reaction:</strong> Indian equity indices faced pressure following the rate hike, while bond yields climbed to 7.27% and the rupee saw volatility as the central bank signaled that future policy actions will be limited to hikes or pauses.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinwFBVV95cUxNQmtqVUJpVDJPazVPNFFnQzl4NnZsblQ0Vkhld0Vqd2x6ME9nSEhNT2lhei1lT2gwanFmSjh4RV9FTGR0Qnk0Wmdac3ZMWjlQeU5mQkpvd00yMEJmOThqWGhyamtpX0dZS2g3dERRT0Q1cDU5VVI4UnV1TnNaYTkxT1dvM1paQmFFWUU4TlVGZEhPOWxOWVc0NVFQNWg2dnM?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I24</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I82</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I98</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>
